log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Each day kill the national criminal plus everyone from forum, foreign, radio and regional:South. That is about 9 a day, and 40 or more in 5 days gives x4. SKIP hospital, because a sector constraint cuts the pool to 20% and is the strongest. Use quick entries in the afternoon. Morning would also rule out students; afternoon only rules out day workers, so the expected pool is about 55000 after routine filtering. Risk: if all 4 of my followed kinds are reachable by L, the pool goes to about 55000/64 = 860 and I am caught. Expected safe case: about 3400. WATCH the press conferences: if the pool falls toward 3000 or below and keeps dropping, drop one category (e.g. regional) to stop further cuts. If the pool is still above about 5000 after many traces, consider adding hospital. Day 1: killed 9 (national, forum x2, radio x2, South x2, foreign x2), all afternoon quick.
